verdict.rationale: Abacum's own docs claim statements built from live ERP actuals are "traceable when they question them" and offer "drill-down to source data" in consolidated three statements, which covers tracing a number back to its source lines. Nothing shows tracing through the formulas or calculation chain that produced a number. Both claims are brief marketing statements with no hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: formula/calculation-lineage tracing, detailed docs on drill-down depth to individual source lines, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, any number in a report traces back through the formulas and source lines that produced it

citations.quote: so the numbers are current when someone asks and traceable when they question them
Real-time consolidation of the three statements with drill-down to source data.
